newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Oklahoma feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Oklahoma feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.

text.p: USDA said Trade inactive in the panhandle area late Tuesday. Slaughter steers and heifers were not tested at the close.
Feedlots reported light inquiry from buyers. Confirmed sales for the week to date include 12,400 head formulated and 900 head previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week.
Confirmed: None Week Ago: 3,500 Year Ago: 400
Wk to Date: 13,300 Week Ago: 16,200 Year Ago: 17,300
